name: Progress Sync
description: Adds a "Sync progress" button to movie, series, season, episode and collection pages in the web client. Copy another user's resume position and watched state to your account once, or link a movie, series or collection to keep it in sync (follow or two-way). Requires the File Transformation plugin.
overview: Copy or keep watch progress in sync between users

versions.changelog: Added collection sync: copy or keep in sync every movie and episode in a collection.
